notes.title: The November update is now available!
notes.content:
We are very happy to announce that the November update is now available! The following are the additions in this version (0.7.9):

[list]
[*] New theme song for Pluto
[*] New life system during combat
[*] New Steam achievements
[*] New selection menu art
[*] Graphical improvements for some guardians and environments
[*] Fixed some bugs in the movement system
[*] Fixed some visual bugs in the combat scenes
[/list]

Remember that you can use our Discord channel, email, or the Steam community to report any bugs you find.

Thank you very much for being part of this adventure!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904636/6186941e1d478c58f543c42596ed7d7d2f8bf43f.gif[/img]

notes.title: Dux Solaris is being received very positively. Thank you so much!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that our game has received a warm reception. We appreciate the enthusiasm and support from our player community, which motivates us to continue improving and offering an incredible experience. Thank you for being part of this adventure with us.

All that's left to say is: thank you all very much!

P.S. We already have the November patch ready. ;)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904636/e85aeab42ed39af98c50338442bac97d24bd421e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: The early access of Dux Solaris is available now
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that Dux Solaris is now available, and given this, we would like to share a bit about what we have prepared for future updates:

[list]
[*] New characters.
[*] New game mode "Classic Arcade."
[*] New animations and poses.
[*] Cloud saving on Steam.
[*] Compatibility with controllers and Steam Deck.
[/list]

Additionally, we would like you to know our manifesto regarding Dux Solaris. At Skyticco, we are a very small team that grew up with games that are now considered classics. Therefore, we want to commit to providing the best experience for our players. We want to tell you that we do not believe in paid content, and all future content for Dux Solaris (DLC, characters, etc.) will be available for everyone who purchases Dux Solaris, and you will not have to pay anything extra for the content we create, including more characters and game modes.

We thank you very much for being part of this journey that starts today.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904636/6186941e1d478c58f543c42596ed7d7d2f8bf43f.gif[/img]

notes.title: Demo version 2.0.1 Released!
notes.content:
Greetings, friends.

We are very pleased to announce that we have a new version of our demo ready for download.

The changes included in the 2.0.1 demo version:

- The combat is now against AI.
- New control scheme available.
- In-game manual.
- Improvements in graphics and gameplay.
- Extras section with 6 downloadable items.

We hope you enjoy it and leave us your comments about this project that we have embarked on out of love for NSFW games!

notes.title: It's time to try the demo!
notes.content:
It is an honor for us to have you test our first version of the Dux Solaris demo. Share your opinions and feedback with us on Discord.

This demo version has limited content compared to the launch version. Some notable differences available in the launch version are:

- All Stellae available.
- Smoother animations.
- New sprites.
- All abilities.
